title: The Torn Page Corner
youtube_title: The Torn Page Corner | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Chioma is tangled up with a page corner torn by a careless turn and almost hides it. Chioma tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
